description: This file defines the AddressRule class, a utility class for parsing and refining address field panels in the SuiteCRM system. It extends a base rule class and provides methods to identify address fields, remove street field overrides, and ensure address field consistency across different views.

classes.name: AddressRule
classes.description: A utility class for refining address-related panels and fields within SuiteCRM, used during metadata processing to manage address field visibility and structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the AddressRule class. Currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Processes the given panels to refine address field handling based on the view context and panel name, including removal or adjustment of address fields.

methods.name: hasAddressFieldsIntact
methods.description: Checks if all necessary address fields (street, city, state, country, postal code) are present for a given address suffix within a panel.

methods.name: removeStreetFieldOverride
methods.description: Replaces the array definition of the street address field with a string, effectively overriding any previous array configuration for that field.
